content.title: Hyperscale Data Unveils Bold Bitcoin Treasury Plan
content.summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. (AMEX:GPUS) saw its shares slip in Tuesday's premarket trading after unveiling plans to purchase roughly $20 million worth of Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC/USD) for its treasury. The move will be financed in part through proceeds from its recently announced at-the-market equity offering.
